values: 一名沉稳坚韧的坦克，在战斗中能够扎根来获得更多进攻能力。
A resilient Tank who can withstand attacks and become more offensive in battle.
Witness the power of the forest.
森林永远庇护着孩子们……
The forest will always protect its children.
每一圈树轮，都是岁月的痕迹。
Each ring of a tree is a wheel of time.
听，落叶的声音，森林在对你说话。
Listen to the sound of falling leaves. The forest is whispering to you.
哦，瞧瞧这小家伙，还有点害羞。
It's okay to be shy, little one.
Oh, why is my beard always itching?
The forest bears witness to all that you've done.
岁月留下了深痕，诉说着森林的过往。
Bound by time, the keeper stands as the forest's living legend.
守卫暮色下的的繁盛与静谧。
A guardian of twilight's bloom, where peace and life flourish.
有顶的房子，不适合树啊
A roofed house isn't suitable for trees.
Please give me some fresh water...
Snow has settled on my leaves.
Please give me some fresh water...
I'll hang a few lanterns myself.
奥曼斯常常忘记自己的年纪，躲在他树丛下捡果子的小松鼠们会帮忙提醒，捡一颗松子的说一百岁，捡两颗松子的说是两百岁。
Ulmus often forgets about his age, so the squirrels gathering nuts in his branches will help remind him. Some say he's a hundred. Others say two. He rewards them no matter what they say.
奥曼斯经历了许多故事，年轻的绿裔，森林的小动物，甚至是刚刚开放的铃兰花，都很喜欢围绕着奥曼斯，听他讲过去的故事。
Ulmus has been through a lot in his long life. Young Wilders, woodland animals, and even the glimmerblooms of the forest visit him to listen to his stories.
奥曼斯喜欢用树枝和藤蔓为朋友们解决烦恼，无论是失去巢穴的鸟雀，还是误中了打猎陷阱的小鹿，都接受过奥曼斯的善意。
Ulmus often helps the creatures of the forest with his extra branches and vines. Be it birds who have lost their nests or deer caught in traps, many have been helped by his kindness.
森林常常要经受许多考验，譬如雷鸣和天火。每到这时，奥曼斯就会直起佝偻的腰背，为生活在林中的万物，撑起一片天。
Thunderstorms and wildfires often befall the forest. At such times, Ulmus will utilize his big magical body to become a pillar of support for all the creatures in the forest.
雷火之后，森林一片焦芜，呜呜哀泣之声不绝。面对颓丧，奥曼斯张开臂膀，枝叶绵延，所及之处……就是新的森林。

Once upon a time, a great fire reduced the forest to nothing but scorched earth and sorrowful cries. Amidst despair, Ulmus opened his arms and spread his branches as far as he could, and then magically, a new forest was formed.
没有人知道森林从何而来，但没有人否认，森林比任何生物都更早在大地上扎根。因此大家都会称呼奥曼斯为——奥曼斯爷爷。
No one knows the origin of the forest, but it is an irrefutable fact that the forest has existed on this land longer than any creatures. That's why everyone calls Ulmus "Grandpa Ulmus".
一代代生物在森林庇护下长大，奥曼斯脸上的刻痕却越来越深。树轮是岁月留下的风霜，也是不必言说就会让人敬佩的勋章。
Ulmus' face bears deep lines from years of guarding the forest, earning him respect from all woodland creatures.
奥曼斯会回应每一个小生灵的祈求，即使他们要跳到他背上，在他的头发里捉迷藏。他喜欢和小生灵嬉戏，即使代价是被扯掉几根胡子。

Ulmus is happy to respond to every prayer of the little creatures. He doesn't mind them jumping on his back and playing hide-and-seek. He enjoys having fun with the little ones, even at the cost of few branches.
奥曼斯随和亲切，很少有人见到奥曼斯生气的样子，除了有人带斧子闯进森林那回。奥曼斯掀起了巨石，狠狠砸向那些破坏森林的人。

Being easygoing and mild-tempered, Ulmus rarely loses his temper, except for the time when some thugs brought axes into the forest. Ulmus lifted an enormous rock and smashed it mercilessly on those who tried to cut down the trees.
年轻的绿裔和小动物有无穷无尽的问题，奥曼斯总是能耐心风趣地解答他们的疑问。“有问题，找奥曼斯爷爷就对了！”小家伙们如是说。
Ulmus always answers the endless questions of the young wilders and small animals with patience and humor. The little ones would always say, "You have a question? Just go ask Grandpa Ulmus!"
老朋友，你一点没变……哎哟哟！
You haven't changed a bit, my old friend... Ouch!
